sites.ownership: The Source Control controller owns the sidebar state behind one Rc<RefCell>.
sites.justification: Refresh, commit, stage, unstage, and diff callbacks all complete asynchronously on the main loop and need one cancellable, generation-aware UI state owner.

sites.ownership: The Source Control state owns a weak self handle for row action callbacks.
sites.justification: List rows are rebuilt frequently; weak callbacks prevent buttons from keeping the sidebar state alive after window teardown.

sites.ownership: Source Control row rendering borrows the weak sidebar state handle.
sites.justification: Per-row buttons must call back into the current sidebar state without cloning or owning the controller from every rebuilt row.

sites.ownership: Source Control action buttons borrow the weak sidebar state handle.
sites.justification: Stage, unstage, and diff button callbacks need to start cancellable Git operations only if the sidebar state is still alive.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns the Gio subprocess pipe flags.
sites.justification: V9 allows subprocess use only here to run bundled /app/bin/git with typed operations, no shell, bounded output, fixed env, and reviewable argv construction.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns stdout capture for sandbox Git.
sites.justification: Git status, attributes, blob reads, and commit responses are bounded and parsed only through this reviewed runner.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns stderr capture for sandbox Git.
sites.justification: Captured stderr is size-capped and mapped to user-facing errors without exposing a generic command runner.

sites.ownership: The typed Git process boundary owns subprocess creation.
sites.justification: All Git subprocess invocations go through the allowlisted operation methods in this file and use bundled /app/bin/git, no host PATH lookup, no shell, and deterministic environment overrides.

sites.ownership: The Git process tests own a one-shot callback result slot.
sites.justification: Typed Git operations report through Rc callbacks; the test slot captures immediate callback results without sharing state outside the test.

sites.ownership: The Git process async tests own a one-shot callback result slot.
sites.justification: The helper pumps the GLib main context until the typed Git callback completes and removes pending timeout sources before leaving the test.
